## Hinge · Starting point and direction {#fv6-hinge .fv-lesson .circle-lesson }

```{=html}
<div data-module="hinge" data-correct="3" class="hinge numeric-choices"><div class="hinge-question"><div class="fv-equation"><span data-math="\underset{\sim}{r}(t)=(2+3\sin t)\underset{\sim}{i}+(-1+3\cos t)\underset{\sim}{j},\quad 0\le t\le 2\pi"></span></div><p>Where does it start, and in which direction is it traced as <span data-math="t"></span> increases?</p></div><div class="hinge-toolbar"><div class="time" role="timer" aria-label="Time remaining">1:00</div><div class="toolbar"><label>Seconds <select class="timer-duration" aria-label="Question duration"><option>30</option><option>45</option><option selected>60</option><option>90</option><option>120</option></select></label><button class="timer-start primary">Start</button><button class="reset-question">Reset</button></div></div><div class="choices"><button class="choice" data-answer="1" aria-pressed="false"><b>1</b><span>Starts at <span data-math="(5,-1)"></span>, anticlockwise.</span></button><button class="choice" data-answer="2" aria-pressed="false"><b>2</b><span>Starts at <span data-math="(2,2)"></span>, anticlockwise.</span></button><button class="choice" data-answer="3" aria-pressed="false"><b>3</b><span>Starts at <span data-math="(2,2)"></span>, clockwise.</span></button><button class="choice" data-answer="4" aria-pressed="false"><b>4</b><span>Starts at <span data-math="(5,-1)"></span>, clockwise.</span></button></div><div class="hinge-bottom"><p>Fist on chest. Think quietly.<br>On “show”, hold up 1–4 fingers.</p><button class="reveal-answer primary">Reveal answer</button></div><div class="hinge-explanation" hidden><strong>3.</strong> <span data-math="t=0"></span> gives <span data-math="(2,2)"></span>; <span data-math="t=\pi/2"></span> gives <span data-math="(5,-1)"></span>. Top → right is clockwise.</div></div>
```

<div class="booklet-cue">Additional diagnostic question</div>

::: {.notes}
Correct answer 3. The centre is (2,−1); t=0 gives the top (2,2) and t=π/2 gives the rightmost point (5,−1). Increasing t therefore traces clockwise. Distractor 1 applies the familiar cos/sin order without reading the equation. Distractor 2 assumes increasing t always means anticlockwise. Distractor 4 recognises clockwise tracing but substitutes incorrectly at zero. Ready: move to Example 3.21. Divided: compare t=0 and t=π/2, then revote. Needs explanation: return to the swapped-order visual and reveal the first two points. Default 60 seconds; adjustable Start/Pause/Resume, Reset and a separate teacher-controlled answer reveal. Timer expiry must leave the answer hidden. Everyone responds simultaneously with 1–4 fingers.
:::
